## 🌟 Task Description
Clear and concise description of the task.

## 🎯 Scope
- [ ] Good for first-time open source contributors
- [ ] Clear step-by-step guidance provided
- [ ] No breaking changes

## 📁 Key Files to Inspect
- `src/...`
- `src/test/...`

## 💡 Implementation Hint
1. Open file `...`
2. Look at function `...`
3. Add the proposed logic or test case

## 🧪 How to Test
```bash
npm test
npm run lint
```
